s: Din ek linhog biqdushshat hattepillin ubo y"a seipim: asur litlot tepillin al hayyated, ben baretzuot vehabbattim teluyim lematta, ben babbattim veharetzuot teluyot lematta, mippene shehu derek bizzayon. Umikkol maqom, beaqray bealma sheochez hattepillin beyado veharetzuot teluyot lematta — en lehaqpid. Abal im hattepillin teluyim — asur apillu beaqray bealma. Veen biklal zeh mah shehattepillin shel rosh teluya baavir umachaziqin bayyad baretzuot umesimin al harosh, ki zehu tzorek hanachatan:

Keshehen bekisan — muttar litlotan. Abal seper tora — asur litlotah apillu bekisah. Vesiddurim haqqebuim beluchot shebbahen shalshelet shel kesep — asur litlotan bah, shehalluchot enan domot lakkis, lepi shehen mechubbarot lassiddur, vahare hen kassiddur atzmo:

Bayit sheyyesh bo tepillin — asur leshammesh bo mittato, ad sheyyotzien, o sheyyaaseh lipnehem mechitztza gaboah asara tepachim ap al pi shehen megullin, o sheyyekassen shene kissuyim keli betok keli. Vehu sheen hashsheni meyuchad lahem, o shehachitzon meyuchad lahem vehappenimi en meyuchad lahem, veen tzarik lomar im shenehem enan meyuchadim lahem, abal im shenehem meyuchadim vaapillu mea shehem meyuchadim lahem — chashubim kikli echad, ap al pi sheen mannichin leolam hattepillin kemo shehen betok hachitzon, ella mannichin otan betok happenimi vehappenimi betok hachitzon. Lepikak otan hammannichin kis hattepillin vehattallit letok kis gadol — hare gam kis haggadol niqra kelyan hamyuchad lahen, vetzarik od keli al gabban. Ak im kis hattepillin mechubbar lemala al kis haggadol — hare tzad hashsheni shel kis haggadol eno niqra kelyan, umoil lahen im hapako:
Im paras tallit al gabbe kis shel tepillin shemmunnach, ap al pi sheenah keruka tachtayv millematta — muttar:

Im hammezuza qebua bipnim becheder — yesh mi shemmatzrik keli betok keli, dehaynu lekassotah bishne kissuyin, veim yesh zekukit al hashshem day biprisat sudar echad al hazzekukit. Veyesh mi sheomer shemmezuza kevan sheqqebua kullah bakkotel veen bah ella neqeb bilbad — day sheyyistom et hanneqeb bachatikat shaava o dabar acher shemmebattelo sham, veen tzarik keli betok keli, lepi shehakkotel choleq reshut leatzmo lekol mah shebbetoko kesheen neqeb patuach mishsham labbayit. Veap im hammezuza qebua bishpoperet — mikkol maqom kevan shehi mechubberet lakkotel hare hi kekotel. Abal setimat zekukit — enah moelet, shekkevan shehammezuza niret derek hazzekukit — asur, kemo sheaseru erva baashashit mishshum "lo yireh beka ervat dabar", vetashmish hammitta hi gam ken genay vedomeh leerva, vetzarik setima gemura sheen hammezuza niret mittokah. Veyesh lismok al debarayv lehaqel bedibre soperim, besheggam sheyyesh lomar sheap mi shehitzrik keli betok keli — lo hitzrik ella bikli lebad, mippene sheeno mebattelo sham, veeno moil listom petichat neqeb hakkotel labbayit shello yehe kol mah shebbetoko niddon keillu hu betok habbayit:

Apillu hinnichan keli betok keli — asur lehannichan tachat margelotayv, apillu en ishto immo, mippene shennoheg bahen minhag bizzayon. Veken lehannichan bammitta keneged tziddo — dinam ketachat margelotayv. Vaapillu tachat meraashotayv — asur keneged rosho apillu keli betok keli apillu en ishto immo. Abal shello keneged rosho, im en ishto immo — muttar apillu shello bikli kelal, raq sheyyannichen beinyan shello yitgalgelu mishsham litzdadin, kegon shehinnichan ben kar hattachton lakkar shettachat rosho, shello keneged rosho. Veim ishto immo — tzarik keli betok keli, dehaynu sheyyannichem betok keli echad vehakkar shettachat rosho hu keli sheni. Velo hittiru chakamim lehanniach tepillin tachat meraashotayv (kesheishto immo) apillu keli betok keli, ella kede sheyyishtammeru min haggannabim vehaakbarim, ulepikak im yesh lo maqom acher shemmishtammerin sham lo yannichen kelal bammitta:

Haya yotze mehammitta maqom shehu gaboah shelosha tepachim lemala meraashotayv o namuk shelosha tepachim lematta meraashotayv — muttar lehannichan alayv ap al pi sheishto immo bammitta ubilbad sheyyannicheha keli betok keli:

Ishto immo veeno rotzeh leshammesh — niqra en ishto immo. Veyesh mi sheoser lihyot ishto immo bammitta ad sheyyanniach hattepillin vehasseparim shebbacheder keli betok keli, shemma yishkach alehen vishammesh. (Venakon lachosh lidbarayv ap al pi sheen issur baddabar min haddin, shehare min haddin muttar lishon im ishto betisha beab veen chosheshin shemma yishkach, ella shennakon haddabar lehachamir kemo sheyyitbaer siman taqanad):

Shakach veshimmesh mittato bitpillin — lo yeechoz lo babbattim velo baretzuot ad sheyyittol yadayv, mippene shehayyadayim asqaniyyot hen veshemma nageu bimqom hattinnopet, umiyyad shennotel yadayv — tzarik lecholtzan ad sheyyeqannach haqqeri im yeshno alayv, veaz yakol lachazor ulelobshan, shebbaal qeri muttar bitpillin leachar sheqqinnach haqqeri, abal lo beod shehaqqeri alayv:

Shakach veyashan bahen veraa qeri vetzarik lesalleqan beod shehaqqeri alayv — lo yeechoz babbattim, ella yeechoz baretzuot umesiran ad sheyyeqannach haqqeri mealayv veyittol yadayv. Abal lo yittol yadayv miyyad shenneor mishshenato, mippene sheen lachosh bahem kol-kak shemma nageu bimqom hattinnopet kesheyyashan, shettehe netilatan keday lehashhot alayv hattepillin beod shehaqqeri alayv ad sheyyittol yadayv. Veap-al-pi-ken en mattirin lo leechoz babbattim, kevan sheepshar al yede haretzuot. Abal beshimmesh mittato — en mattirim apillu al yede haretzua, hoil vehayyadayim asqaniyyot hen:

Hanniknas lisudat qeba — choletzan umannichan al hashshulchan, sheyyehe mezummanim lo bishat gemar hasseuda, sheyyachazor vinichen alayv qodem birkat hammazon. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bisudat qeba sheyyesh lachosh shemma yishtakker veyitganneh bitpillayv, abal laakilat aray — en tzarik lecholtzan kelal:
